guidance.service: Describe service scope, coverage, rate basis, availability and exclusions. Do not imply a physical product or invent credentials.
guidance.job: Describe the genuine role, employer, duties, requirements, work mode and salary period. Do not invent salaries or qualifications.
guidance.business: Describe only this item and confirmed seller facts. Preserve all defects, exclusions and unknowns. State your authority and the transfer process. This is a seller declaration, not verification of legal ownership. Supporting media is optional; identity/profile and abuse checks still apply.
guidance.land-rent: Describe area with its unit, rent period, deposit, furnishing and availability. Do not invent legal authority or tenancy terms.
guidance.accessory: State the accessory type, connector, exact compatible models and the rating printed on the label. Compatibility and authenticity need the seller’s confirmation; never guess from its appearance.
guidance.wearable: Give the watch or wearable model, size, connectivity, supported operating system and observed battery backup. Do not invent health accuracy, water resistance or battery condition.
guidance.landline: Mention the telephone model, wired/cordless/VoIP type, handset count and included base or adapter. Confirm line compatibility.
guidance.mobile-number: Describe the network and masked number pattern. Do not post identity documents, OTPs or full private contact numbers in the description. The parties must confirm ownership and the operator’s transfer process. Verification and media rules remain in force. State your authority and the transfer process. This is a seller declaration, not verification of legal ownership. Supporting media is optional; identity/profile and abuse checks still apply.
guidance.audio: Describe the exact audio equipment, inputs/outputs, channel count and rated power if labelled. Include observed distortion, port problems and missing components.
guidance.controller: State controller/system compatibility and connection type. Disclose stick drift, worn buttons and battery or pairing issues only as reported.
guidance.power-equipment: Give the generator, UPS, battery or solar equipment model and label ratings with their units. State usage/backup as measured by the seller; do not promise runtime or installation compatibility.
guidance.tool: Identify the tool, power source, labelled capacity, included attachments and known wear. Do not assume professional certification or electrical safety.
guidance.pet-food: State the animal species, product type, amount, seal and label expiry if known. Do not invent expiry, make veterinary claims or recommend treatment.
guidance.pet-accessory: State the animal this item is intended for, dimensions, material and included parts. Mention wear, leaks or missing components.
guidance.footwear: State size and size system, intended fit, material and observed sole/upper wear. Do not invent authenticity or advertise multiple sizes unless offered.
guidance.textile: Give the fabric item, dimensions with units, material, piece count and known stains, tears or fading.
guidance.lighting: Give the light or fitting type, labelled wattage/voltage and dimensions. Mention missing fittings and known defects; no inferred safety certification.
guidance.kitchenware: State the utensil or kitchen set, material, dimensions/capacity, piece count and chips, scratches or missing pieces. Do not guess coating or heat compatibility.
guidance.craft: Describe the craft supply or collectable, dimensions, material, quantity and provenance only if known. Do not infer rarity, age, authenticity or value.
guidance.farm-produce: Describe the exact item, quantity with its unit, packaging and known issues. Copy dates and product details only from the seller or label. Leave unknown facts blank. Do not claim certification, authenticity, medical effectiveness or safe use without evidence.
